title: Git at swarm speed, with dots
what: /swarm.html (and the landing page) explains with dots why thirty agents jam the old git way: one lane, a merge wall, a red-check wall. Then each layer takes one down: a Durable Object for a wide lane, Mervin seating PRs on the bullet train, Ester stacking the test stations. A story with wipes between scenes, old git, layer-by-layer switches, side by side, and faders for speed, agents, overlap and red checks.
